title.sl: Present continuous: kaj se dogaja zdaj
title.it: Il present continuous: ciò che succede ora
title.de: Das present continuous: was gerade passiert

rule.en:
The present continuous is for what is happening now, at this moment: **am / is / are + the verb with -ing**: **Jack is walking the dogs now.** **I'm reading.** **They're playing.** Negative: **She isn't sleeping.** Question: **Are you listening?**

Compare the present simple, for habits: **Jack walks the dogs every day.** (always) → **Jack is walking the dogs now.** (at this moment). **now**, **at the moment**, **Look!** and **Listen!** go with the continuous.

Spelling: a silent -e drops: make → **making**, come → **coming**. A short word with one vowel + one consonant doubles the consonant: sit → **sitting**, run → **running**, swim → **swimming**. -ie becomes -y: lie → **lying**.

Verbs for states are not used with -ing: **know**, **like**, **love**, **want**, **need**, **understand**: **I know** (not *I'm knowing*).

It is also for plans already arranged: **I'm coming on Saturday.**
rule.sl:
*present continuous* je za to, kar se dogaja zdaj, v tem trenutku: **am / is / are + glagol z -ing**: **Jack is walking the dogs now.** (Jack zdaj sprehaja pse.) **I'm reading.** **They're playing.** Zanikanje: **She isn't sleeping.** Vprašanje: **Are you listening?**

Slovenščina ima en sedanjik, angleščina pa loči. Navada je *present simple*: **Jack walks the dogs every day.** Dogajanje prav zdaj je continuous: **Jack is walking the dogs now.** Z njim gredo **now**, **at the moment**, **Look!** in **Listen!**.

Pravopis: nemi -e odpade: make → **making**, come → **coming**. Kratka beseda z enim samoglasnikom in enim soglasnikom na koncu soglasnik podvoji: sit → **sitting**, run → **running**, swim → **swimming**. -ie postane -y: lie → **lying**.

Glagoli za stanja ne dobijo -ing: **know**, **like**, **love**, **want**, **need**, **understand**: **I know** (ne *I'm knowing*).

Z njim povemo tudi dogovorjene načrte: **I'm coming on Saturday.** (V soboto pridem.)
rule.it:
Il *present continuous* è per ciò che succede adesso, in questo momento: **am / is / are + il verbo in -ing**: **Jack is walking the dogs now.** (Jack sta portando a spasso i cani.) **I'm reading.** **They're playing.** Negazione: **She isn't sleeping.** Domanda: **Are you listening?**

Somiglia a stare + gerundio (sto leggendo), ma in inglese è obbligatorio: per adesso l'italiano può dire «leggo», l'inglese dice solo **I'm reading**. Per le abitudini c'è il *present simple*: **Jack walks the dogs every day.** → **Jack is walking the dogs now.** Con il continuous vanno **now**, **at the moment**, **Look!** e **Listen!**.

Ortografia: la -e muta cade: make → **making**, come → **coming**. Una parola breve con una vocale e una consonante finale raddoppia la consonante: sit → **sitting**, run → **running**, swim → **swimming**. -ie diventa -y: lie → **lying**.

I verbi di stato non prendono -ing: **know**, **like**, **love**, **want**, **need**, **understand**: **I know** (non *I'm knowing*).

Si usa anche per i programmi già fissati: **I'm coming on Saturday.** (Vengo sabato.)
rule.de:
Das *present continuous* steht für das, was jetzt gerade passiert: **am / is / are + Verb mit -ing**: **Jack is walking the dogs now.** (Jack geht gerade mit den Hunden spazieren.) **I'm reading.** **They're playing.** Verneinung: **She isn't sleeping.** Frage: **Are you listening?**

Das Deutsche hat nur ein Präsens und sagt höchstens *gerade*; das Englische trennt: Gewohnheit ist *present simple* (**Jack walks the dogs every day.**), jetzt gerade ist continuous (**Jack is walking the dogs now.**). Dazu passen **now**, **at the moment**, **Look!** und **Listen!**.

Schreibung: stummes -e fällt weg: make → **making**, come → **coming**. Ein kurzes Wort mit einem Vokal und einem Konsonanten am Ende verdoppelt den Konsonanten: sit → **sitting**, run → **running**, swim → **swimming**. -ie wird -y: lie → **lying**.

Verben für Zustände bekommen kein -ing: **know**, **like**, **love**, **want**, **need**, **understand**: **I know** (nicht *I'm knowing*).

Auch für feste Pläne: **I'm coming on Saturday.** (Ich komme am Samstag.)
